name: Subfield.closure_le
script:
intro K inst s t
have h_main : Subfield.closure s ≤ t ↔ s ⊆ (↑t : Set K) := by
  constructor
  · -- Prove the forward direction: if `Subfield.closure s ≤ t`, then `s ⊆ (↑t : Set K)`
    intro h x hx
    have h₁ : x ∈ Subfield.closure s := by
      apply Subfield.subset_closure
      exact hx
    have h₂ : x ∈ (t : Set K) := by
      -- Since `Subfield.closure s ≤ t`, we can use the fact that `x` is in `Subfield.closure s` to show it is in `t`
      have h₃ : Subfield.closure s ≤ t := h
      exact h₃ h₁
    simpa using h₂
  · -- Prove the backward direction: if `s ⊆ (↑t : Set K)`, then `Subfield.closure s ≤ t`
    intro h x hx
    have h₁ : x ∈ Subfield.closure s := by
      apply Subfield.subset_closure
      exact hx
    have h₂ : x ∈ (t : Set K) := by
      -- Since `s ⊆ (↑t : Set K)`, we can use the fact that `x` is in `Subfield.closure s` to show it is in `t`
      have h₃ : x ∈ s := by simpa using hx
      exact h h₃
    simpa using h₂
exact h_main

name: UniqueAdd.of_card_le_one
script:
intro G _ A B hA_nonempty hB_nonempty hA_card_le_one hB_card_le_one
have hA_card_eq_one : A.card = 1 := by
  have h₁ : A.Nonempty := hA_nonempty
  have h₂ : A.card ≤ 1 := hA_card_le_one
  have h₃ : A.card ≥ 1 := by
    apply Finset.card_pos.mpr
    exact h₁
  have h₄ : A.card = 1 := by
    omega
  exact h₄

have hB_card_eq_one : B.card = 1 := by
  have h₁ : B.Nonempty := hB_nonempty
  have h₂ : B.card ≤ 1 := hB_card_le_one
  have h₃ : B.card ≥ 1 := by
    apply Finset.card_pos.mpr
    exact h₁
  have h₄ : B.card = 1 := by
    omega
  exact h₄

-- We now know that A and B each have exactly one element.
-- We can use this to find the unique elements a ∈ A and b ∈ B.
obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hA_card_eq_one
obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hB_card_eq_one
refine' ⟨a, ha, b, hb, _⟩
-- We need to show that the pair (a, b) is unique in A × B.
simp [ha, hb, Finset.mem_product]
<;>
  aesop
